description:
Read a manual. Required fields depend on the retrieval mode:

        1. Name lookup: name. Example: {"name":"ls"}. Optional product pins a distro.
           Without OS/version filters, select the newest upstream version across active catalogs.
           Different packages or sections remain ambiguous; provenance identifies the chosen distro.
        2. ID lookup: page_id copied from a previous result; omit name-based filters.
        3. Continuation: cursor copied from get_man_page.next_cursor; omit name-based filters.
           A matching page_id may also be supplied. max_chars is optional in every mode.

        With product, os_version defaults to latest (null also means latest): the newest
        numbered release with readable documentation for the requested architecture/locale.
        Pass an explicit release such as 44 to pin it. Responses identify the actual OS release.
        A missing manual never falls back to an older OS.
        page_id and cursor retain their own release.

        Version accepts exact EVR (2:1.35-9.fc44), version-release (1.35-9.fc44), or upstream
        version (1.35). No operators or ranges: >=1.35 is invalid. RPM ~ and ^ characters
        are allowed in exact versions. Omit version for current documentation. An unavailable
        version never falls back; alternatives list only readable manuals. Ambiguity returns
        page_id choices. Alternatively pass only page_id from search, or only cursor to
        continue a long page. max_chars bounds each response; next_cursor=null means finished.

architecture.description: Optional target CPU architecture from list_targets; defaults to x86_64. Includes compatible noarch packages. Repeat this filter for search continuation; manual page IDs/cursors already pin the architecture.
architecture.title: Architecture

cursor.description: Alternative to name + product: copy next_cursor from get_man_page to continue that manual. Omit name-based filters. A null next_cursor means no more content.
cursor.title: Cursor

locale.description: Optional manual language from list_targets; defaults to en. Repeat for search continuation; manual page IDs/cursors already pin the locale.
locale.title: Locale

max_chars.description: Optional maximum content characters per response (1000–24000; default 12000). May be changed during manual continuation; follow next_cursor for more content.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

name.description: Required for name lookup. Manual name without its section suffix. Omit when supplying page_id or cursor.
name.title: Name

os_version.description: Optional OS release, distinct from the package version. Without product, omitted/latest/null compares upstream versions across active catalogs. With product, it selects the newest numbered release. Keep the default with page_id or cursor, which already pin the release.
os_version.title: Os Version

package.description: Optional RPM package-name filter, which may differ from the command name. Applies to name lookups and searches, including search continuation.
package.title: Package

page_id.description: Alternative to name + product: copy page_id verbatim from a previous manual or search result. Omit name-based filters. May accompany a cursor for that same page.
page_id.title: Page Id

product.description: Optional product filter. Omit to select the newest upstream package version across published OS catalogs. Use a product from list_targets. Omit when supplying page_id or cursor.
product.title: Product

section.description: Optional manual section filter. Helps disambiguate commands, functions and file formats. Applies to name lookups and searches, including search continuation.
section.title: Section

version.description: Optional exact package EVR, version-release, or upstream version; not an OS release. Omit for current documentation. Operators/ranges are unsupported. Omit for page_id/cursor retrieval.
version.title: Version

name: get_man_page
title: Read a manual page
